placement_after: Buddy leaned over the edge of his recliner. "Heather. He’s between the chairs." Then he settled back, unable to suppress a quiet snort.
alt_text: Buddy looks down from his comfortable recliner to locate Neet in the gap between the chairs.
scene_brief: Airport lounge with two adjacent tan leather powered recliners. Buddy lies comfortably along the left reclined seat on a soft blanket, long torso supported, head leaning over INNER seat edge to look down into the gap. Neet is awkwardly wedged in the narrow space between chairs after slipping: show head/shoulders above front inner armrest edge, torso continuing diagonally DOWN into gap, two fine forepaws braced on inner cushion edges, hindquarters and hindfeet visible below supported on floor. No disconnected face or extra legs: body ownership clear despite chair occlusion. His ears indignant; Buddy mild amusement but concerned. Scene side-threequarter so entire Neet body path can be traced, no crushing danger. Faint airport glass/aircraft outside, no readable screens or humans. Comedy comfortable brother and unlucky chair conqueror.
